newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens semiconductors to triple sales by 2001.
newsitem.headline: Siemens semiconductors to triple sales by 2001.

text.p: Siemens AG's semiconductors operations will triple sales by 2001 after posting sales of 4.7 billion marks ($2.8 billion) in the 1995/96 business year, division chief Ulrich Schumacher said on Thursday.
In remarks prepared for a speech, Schumacher also said he expected earnings would be positive in the current year to September 30 thanks to an expected pickup in the semiconductor market.
Schumacher said Siemens semiconductors was committing around eight billion marks to a four-year investment programme, of which around half had already been spent.
Despite a gain in sales last year, pre-tax profits fell to 603 million marks from 793 million marks in 1994/95. The division increased its workforce by 3,400 to 19,300.
